item.title: The 'cockroach' in the machine: How Gen Z is rattling South Asia's elites
item.description: South Asia's leaders have long boasted about their demographic dividend. But the region's young people are turning it into a political reckoning.

item.title: 3 dead in mass shooting in Seattle. And, U.S. and Iran pause fighting
item.description: A mass shooting at a Seattle festival has left three people dead. And, the U.S. and Iran have been exchanging diplomatic messages after nearly tw weeks of intense fighting.

item.title: France continues to fight devastating wildfires, while progress is made in Spain
item.description: In southern France, a wildfire in the region of Gironde is still active, while two major fires in central Spain are finally coming under control, ahead of the fourth heat wave of the summer.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Can the U.S. and Iran take the off-ramp?
item.description: The U.S. military has paused its airstrikes on Iran after nearly two weeks of intensifying bombing, while diplomatic efforts have pushed forward to try to avert a return to all-out war.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: U.S. pauses attacks on Iran for a second straight day and Tehran does too
item.description: The United States paused attacks on Iran for a second straight day Sunday and Tehran said it had done so too, as efforts continued to bring the countries back to negotiations on an interim ceasefire.

item.title: Lebanese displaced by war turn to satellites to check their homes
item.description: Unable to return home, some Lebanese displaced by Israel's invasion of southern Lebanon are buying satellite images to see whether their houses survived.

item.title: Suspect in Berlin Pride vehicle attack is dead, police say
item.description: Germany's interior minister Alexander Dobrindt described the incident as a likely "Islamic terror attack," and named the suspect as Abdul Ballout, who was born in Germany and has Lebanese roots.

item.title: France and Spain fires force more than 300,000 to flee homes
item.description: In France, around 50,000 people were evacuated from their homes overnight into Sunday, according to interior minister Laurent Nuñez. At least one person has died in a fire in Spain, officials said.
